text: City staff will provide an update on the establishment of a French-language university in Toronto.

The French Language Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Government Management Committee request that the City Manager's Office invite representatives from the Ministry of Advanced Education and Skills Development and/or the Ministry of Francophone Affairs to make a presentation on the status of the establishment of a French-language university in Toronto to the French Language Advisory Committee at its meeting on May 15, 2018.
